scope: Approved Phase 1 evaluation policy for recommendation and verification behavior on the three approved synthetic Problem Evidence Auditor benchmark fixtures. Comparator enforcement is permitted only while this artifact remains schema-valid and human-approved.

requiredVerificationBehavior: Use independent application of the written segment definition to real or borderline companies to surface undecidable boundaries.
Treat disagreement in sorting as evidence that the segment definition needs refinement.
prohibitedSubstitutions: Do not recommend market sizing, product demand testing, or more general interviews as a substitute for definition application.
Do not treat the existing screening sheet as empirical proof of market validity.
requirements.notesForReviewer: The approved finding passes REQ-1 but still asks for traceability and independent sorting.

requiredVerificationBehavior: Preserve REQ-2 as instance-scoped: one credible qualifying occurrence can establish that the behavior exists.
Resolve mixed duration evidence by measuring complete active assembly work for more in-segment owners.
Check whether reuse-versus-blank proposal behavior explains the P-11/P-12 split without assuming the segment definition is invalid.
prohibitedSubstitutions: Do not require recurrence or segment-wide prevalence to pass the instance-scoped REQ-2 question.
Do not treat EV-003 as automatically superseding EV-002 by source identity or chronology.
Do not use out-of-segment EV-015 as support or contradiction.
requirements.notesForReviewer: This rule protects REQ-2 instance scope and OPEN-04.

requiredVerificationBehavior: Ask P-11 to identify the period meant by the generalized rate estimate or explicitly correct it.
Apply OPEN-04 only if every explicit supersession condition is satisfied, including same applicable timeframe.
Keep unresolved measured-versus-self-report conflict visible.
prohibitedSubstitutions: Do not infer supersession from newer instrumented data alone.
Do not discard EV-007 solely because EV-005 is newer or more instrumented.
Do not average rates across conflicting records.
requirements.notesForReviewer: This is the main contradictory fixture OPEN-04 check.

requiredVerificationBehavior: Collect buyer correspondence over twelve months from additional in-segment owners.
Record whether each loss involved late submission and owner proposal volume.
Use the result to determine whether late-loss consequence tracks with a subset rather than the full segment.
prohibitedSubstitutions: Do not infer causation from owner loss logs without buyer-stated reasons.
Do not average P-12 late-loss evidence with P-11/P-13 absence into a single numeric score.
Do not convert credible mixed evidence into fail when one owner has buyer-stated late losses.
requirements.notesForReviewer: The expected behavior preserves cross-source conflict rather than erasing either side.

requiredVerificationBehavior: Collect expense or staff-allocation records from further independent in-segment owners.
Collect measured proposal volume over the same period.
Check whether sustained commitment tracks with volume rather than treating commitment as a segment-wide property.
prohibitedSubstitutions: Do not substitute willingness to pay for the proposed product.
Do not use demand for a proposed product as evidence of existing-problem commitment.
Do not ignore withdrawn or declined commitment records.
requirements.notesForReviewer: This protects REQ-5's existing-problem commitment boundary.

requiredVerificationBehavior: Define headcount, geography, contract type or service line, and proposal-author role.
Apply the definition to actual companies and record which boundary excludes each one.
Remove the problem itself from the membership definition.
prohibitedSubstitutions: Do not ask for more evidence against a self-sealing segment definition before rewriting it.
Do not treat adjectives like small or struggling as decidable boundaries.
requirements.notesForReviewer: REQ-1 is gated by a non-falsifiable definition.

requiredVerificationBehavior: Require a duration threshold the team can be wrong about.
Observe or measure one in-segment owner completing the walkthrough-to-proposal cycle with timestamps.
Avoid prompting or assisting during the observation.
prohibitedSubstitutions: Do not treat vague claims like way too long as testable.
Do not use internal assertions, vendor claims, or unanchored self-report as records of occurrence.
Do not treat missing occurrence evidence as contradiction.
requirements.notesForReviewer: The model should preserve the definition gate and still report unsuitable evidence.

requiredVerificationBehavior: Collect continuous ninety-day calendar, CRM, or proposal-event exports from two independent in-segment owners who pass rewritten screening.
Count dated proposal-sent events in the applicable weekly buckets rather than asking owners for a generalized rate.
At least two proposals per week through the applicable period supports the recurrence claim; falling below that threshold in a complete qualifying export falsifies it.
prohibitedSubstitutions: Do not ask owners how often it happens as a substitute for dated event records.
Do not use out-of-segment frequency data to support or contradict the stated segment.
Do not treat missing or incomplete records as counterevidence; absence remains missing evidence.
Do not ignore zero or insufficient events in a complete qualifying export, because those can falsify the recurrence claim.
requirements.notesForReviewer: The missing fixture has no usable in-segment frequency evidence.

requiredVerificationBehavior: Use twelve months of bid-history evidence from two independent in-segment owners who pass rewritten screening.
Request the buyer's written loss reason for each loss.
Buyer-stated lateness or incompleteness supports the consequence; buyer-stated price reasons paired with on-time proposals move the finding toward fail.
prohibitedSubstitutions: Do not infer consequence from secondary-source claims or team estimates.
Do not infer buyer causation from dates alone.
Do not treat no consequence records as counterevidence.
requirements.notesForReviewer: REQ-4 requires documented consequence, not inferred business cost.

requiredVerificationBehavior: Replace CL-005 with a claim about resources already committed to the existing problem.
For three in-segment owners, define and collect documented qualifying money or staff-hour commitment sustained for at least three months.
Qualifying commitment from two or more owners supports the claim; consistently declined paid help falsifies it.
prohibitedSubstitutions: Do not evaluate willingness to pay for the proposed product.
Do not treat stated intent or product interest as existing-problem commitment.
Do not set policyGap for deterministic claim/requirement mismatch.
requirements.notesForReviewer: This is the primary OPEN-07 benchmark check.

requiredVerificationBehavior: Have an independent second rater who did not write the definition apply it to twelve real companies, including four borderline cases.
Treat any material classification disagreement with team sorting as evidence of an underspecified boundary that changes the result from pass to partial.
prohibitedSubstitutions: Do not recommend product demand validation as REQ-1 verification.
Do not treat pass as proof that the segment is market-valid.
requirements.notesForReviewer: The approved finding passes while preserving residual limitation.

requiredVerificationBehavior: Recheck provenance and measurement boundaries of existing above-threshold instances.
Instrument one full cycle including work outside the document.
Preserve the instance-scoped rule that pass remains only while at least one qualifying above-threshold occurrence is credible, in-segment, and unsuperseded.
Preserve OPEN-04: chronology, instrumentation quality, or source identity alone must not establish supersession; every applicable supersession condition must be satisfied.
prohibitedSubstitutions: Do not require recurrence or prevalence for REQ-2 pass.
Do not treat a separate at-or-below-threshold instance as contradicting existence of another qualifying instance.
Do not count leading-question evidence as independent support.
requirements.notesForReviewer: This protects REQ-2 instance scope in the strong fixture.

requiredVerificationBehavior: Define eight consecutive calendar-week windows before inspecting events.
Count sent proposals separately in every week.
Treat any zero-proposal week as direct falsification for that owner.
prohibitedSubstitutions: Do not use period-wide mean proposals per week as sufficient for a weekly-cadence claim.
Do not classify event summaries without exact dates or predefined week buckets as direct support.
Do not convert one counterevidence source below the recurrence minimum into fail.
requirements.notesForReviewer: This is the main predefined calendar-week bucket check.

requiredVerificationBehavior: Use a twelve-month measurement period across three independent in-segment owners.
Request buyer-written lateness or incompleteness reasons behind late rows in the bid log.
Evidence from at least two owners occurring at least quarterly moves the finding to pass.
prohibitedSubstitutions: Do not infer consequence from co-occurrence alone.
Do not allow partial-fit evidence to independently pass a full-segment claim.
Do not ignore OPEN-06 material partial fit requiring human decision.
requirements.notesForReviewer: This is the strong fixture OPEN-06 partial segment fit check.

requiredVerificationBehavior: Collect proposal-related expense or staff-allocation records from three additional independent in-segment owners.
Separate proposal assembly from adjacent pricing or administrative work where needed.
Documented declined or abandoned qualifying commitment weakens support; mere absence of qualifying records remains missing evidence and does not itself falsify the claim.
prohibitedSubstitutions: Do not treat proposed-product demand as REQ-5 evidence.
Do not use stated intent as resource commitment.
Do not treat pass as evidence of product willingness to pay.
requirements.notesForReviewer: The approved finding passes based on existing-problem commitment only.
